summary: Second (short) review of the Phase 7 revision c74ffabd. All round-1 findings F1 to F7 are closed in spec.md and plan.md. F1 verified against code and data: resolveStorytimePictureFiles (dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:614) reads the Forge manifest by row id, and content/storytime/l2/print/pictures/manifest.json selects version 2 for the rows a-net, a-nose, and nan-can-nod, so the three approved v2 color files resolve. Phase 7 has no open maker decision left. Phase 8 can run without a decision under the PM context (F5 by design; F6 default keeps A8 in place; F1 counts a/an as the frame word, 'I can see!' does not count; tech-debt triggers pinned). One Nit: the Phase 8 PROJECT_LINT list omits the changed manual and teacher-book test files.

paraphrase.proposes: Phase 7 (revised): ship the 18 approved week-1 book pictures to the Monorepo app by 2026-11-06. The source of each picture is now the resolver resolveStorytimePictureFiles(folder, rows, 'color'), which reads the Forge manifest and picks the selected version per row (v2 for a-net, a-nose, nan-can-nod). The script writes 1600 px JPEGs of 400 KB or less at quality 82 (re-encode at 75 or more if needed, quality recorded), writes provenance with output and resolved source SHA-256 plus quality and sharp version, and adds image.file lines to w01.json. approval.images becomes approved with the exact D7 words; audio and song stay draft; the published detail becomes 'audio not approved; song not approved' and stays the one accepted FAIL. Four pinned test files change. The hand-off folder keeps paths relative to content/storytime/ exactly as w01.json names them, with a workbooks-commit MANIFEST line and a byte-for-byte git show equality rule. Phase 8 (new): two maker tasks from the 2026-11-03 cloud review (the manual recall group fix F6; checks.ts F1 frame-word counting with a/an equal and F2 soundBook gating, plus mutants 62 and 74), one checker, PROJECT_TESTS once, and tech-debt entries with triggers.
paraphrase.current_system: Unchanged from round 1: no shipped week has image.file on a reader page or a cover, so the week-1 app route answers 404. The published check lists each non-approved app part as '<part> not approved' joined with '; ' in key order images, audio, song. The color print pictures live in the git-ignored folder content/storytime/l2/print/pictures/, selected by the committed Forge manifest.json; pictures.json stays pinned to the v1 names by print tests R4b-4 and R4b-5.
